name: GMO Payment Gateway
summary: Based in Tokyo, Japan, and founded in 1995, GMO Payment Gateway, Inc. delivers a wide array of financial services and integrated payment solutions through its three core segments: Payment Enhancement, Payment Processing, and Money Service. The company offers a comprehensive suite of payment platforms, notably the "PG multi-payment service," which supports diverse transaction methods such as credit card, convenience store, account transfer, and multi-currency credit card payments. Other key offerings include "GMO payment after delivery" and the "Ginko Pay Base System," a mobile application that allows immediate debit payments directly from bank accounts. Additionally, GMO Payment Gateway provides the "GMO-PG processing platform," assisting financial institutions and service providers in building their payment infrastructure and ensuring robust security. Its services also extend to global payment solutions and a range of financial products, including early payment, GMO-PG remittance, guarantee services, and transaction lending. Beyond financial services, the company manages online advertising campaigns, providing administrative support for platforms like Yahoo! Promotional Ads, Google AdWords, Facebook Ads, and Google Analytics. GMO Payment Gateway serves a diverse client base, including online merchants, prominent public organizations such as NHK, the National Tax Agency, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, as well as various banks and financial institutions.
